class.name: SteamCloudFilesResult
class.brief_description: Outcome and one bounded page of local Steam Cloud files.

method.name: get_total_count
method.description: Returns the total number of files Steam reported before copying the page. Returns zero on failure.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns a read-only array of detached file snapshots from the page. Returns an empty array on failure.

members.member: The total number of local files observed for this query, including files outside this page.
A read-only array containing the file snapshots from the requested page.
